heading: Rich Culture & Ancient Traditions
intro: Azerbaijan, known as the "Land of Fire," boasts a rich cultural heritage spanning thousands of years — a unique blend of Eastern and Western influences.

items.title: Mugham Music
items.body: A UNESCO-recognized art form — highly complex improvised vocal and instrumental music rooted in centuries of tradition.
items.imageAlt: Folk performers, Xarıbülbül music festival, Shusha

items.title: Azerbaijani Cuisine
items.body: From aromatic plov to delicate dolma and sweet baklava — flavors reflecting the rich tapestry of the Caucasus.
items.imageAlt: Dolma and cheese on a traditional Azerbaijani carpet spread

items.title: Carpet Weaving
items.body: World-renowned for intricate patterns and vibrant colors, each region carrying its own distinctive style.
items.imageAlt: A weaver at the loom, Guba

items.title: Şəbəkə Art
items.body: Hand-cut colored glass assembled into carved wooden lattices, held together entirely without nails or glue.
